newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Singleton sets special div, capital return.
newsitem.headline: Singleton sets special div, capital return.

text.p: Advertising agency Singleton Group Ltd said it will pay a special interim dividend of A$1.70 a share and make a 23 cents a share return of capital.

The two transactions will return to shareholders all proceeds of the sale of Singleton's 10 percent voting stake in The TEN Group Ltd, Australia's third ranked television network, for A$59.15 million, announced in November, the company said.
"This amount (A$1.93 a share) represents more than the original subscription price paid by shareholders to the original float," Singleton said.
Singleton said the special dividend will be paid on July 2 to shareholders registered June 19.
Singleton originally said in December that it planned a special dividend of about A$1.80 following the sale of its TEN stake.
The return of capital is subject to shareholder approval by the next annual general meeting and subsequent court approval.
Singleton shares last traded at A$6.10 on Tuesday.
